description: Check a list of interface labels for consistency. Give `labels` (one per line; repeat a label once per place it appears so counts are real) and optionally `groups` (your own synonym sets, one per line, comma separated). Groups labels that name the same action from a built-in list of about 17 actions (sign in/out/up, delete, cancel, save, edit, add, next, back, buy, view, download, search, send, share, confirm), suggests the most-used label as the standard, and flags mixed Title Case and sentence case, all capitals, inconsistent end punctuation and generic labels. Some groups depend on context; merge only where the action is truly the same.

groups.description: Own synonym sets, one per line, comma separated

labels.description: Labels, one per line, repeated per occurrence

name: button_label_consistency
title: Button label consistency
